# dsh-smooth-stream

> Fluid streaming rendering and silky scrolling for DeepSeek Harness replies.
> 为 DeepSeek Harness 回复带来流畅渲染和丝滑滚动。

## Summary

dsh-smooth-stream brings fluid streaming rendering and silky scrolling to the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI. Text, Markdown, code blocks, tables, and tool results appear as the reply arrives; as content grows, the page follows along in one continuous visual rhythm. The project is independently maintained and MIT-licensed.

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-smooth-stream

## Install

From a DeepSeek Harness source checkout:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-smooth-stream
```

If `dsh` is already on PATH:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-smooth-stream
```

Start the UI:

```sh
pnpm dsh web
```

Host log should show:

```
[dsh-smooth-stream] plugin loaded!
```

## Features

- Fluid rendering: text appears as it arrives while Markdown structure stays active.
- Silky scrolling: growing content follows one continuous scroll path.
- Consistent transitions: line wraps, code blocks, tables, and tool results share the same motion treatment.
- Adaptive cadence: reveal speed responds to arrival rate and pending content.

## FAQ

### Is dsh-smooth-stream an official DeepSeek plugin?

No. It is independently maintained, MIT-licensed software for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI and is not affiliated with DeepSeek.

### How do I install it?

Run `pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-smooth-stream` from a DeepSeek Harness source checkout, or `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-smooth-stream` if `dsh` is already on PATH.

### Can I install it from npm?

Yes. `dsh-smooth-stream` is published to npm. The npm package ships prebuilt `lib/`, so no pnpm >=10 build-script allowance is needed.

### Does it respect prefers-reduced-motion?

Yes. With reduced motion enabled, the plugin shows the finished text at once and does not take over scrolling. If the frame rate drops below 30 fps while the reply is off-screen, reveal pauses and catches up later.
